test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Indira starts from point A, which is 7 km towards East of point B. From point A, she drives 4 km towards East. From here, she takes a left turn and drives 9 km. She then takes a left turn, drives 9 km and stops at point C. If from point C, Indira drives 9 km towards South, how far will she be from point B?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Indira starts from point A, which is 7 km towards East of point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3ccdb2a7b51493a8de45d3a0695562ef3c0a0ef6a39a34e85a367c05a9baf00.png] 

2) From point A, she drives 4 km towards East.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bab478378afdb48a37126990e201fb01c3b4a2f705a939161317718b1e9504d1.png] 

3) From here, she takes a left turn and drives 9 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f1d524e633101c61a0c39e968e63a74d4db2019fc2072633ff5e600a288eeac.png] 

4) She then takes a left turn, drives 9 km and stops at point C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df16323ef50cd1fd6903438c8176985d36a9b35b5dffac20266d262bc385f182.png] 

5) If from point C, Indira drives 9 km towards South.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9113dac44da9e66cdf13bd46e802409e08bb5e22a1f1e02671dad36ef7d27616.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****2 km"**.
